As mentioned in the section on P. chiniana comb. nov., previous records of P. consueta comb nov. from Japan are all doubtful. (2020) represents P. chiniana comb. nov., therefore the occurrence of P. consueta comb. nov. in Korea is in need of confirmation. Discovery of P. consueta comb nov. from Ishigaki Island represents the northernmost reliable distributional record for this species.
